tools.name: get_tool_status
tools.description: Read the available tool's Base USDC price, receiver and setup status. Free; configuration does not prove settlement.

tools.name: preview_base_usdc
tools.description: Free fixed sample of native USDC's on-chain facts on Base. No other token input accepted; does not make a payment.

tools.name: base_token_facts
tools.description: Read a Base ERC-20 fact packet at one pinned block: metadata, exact supply, bytecode hash and EIP-1967 implementation slot. Requires 0.01 native USDC on Base; no financial advice.

tools.name: get_runtime_tools
tools.description: List mounted tool versions, per-call USDC prices and input schemas. Free. Releases share the receiving wallet and pilot limits, not a universal price.

tools.name: base_token_allowance
tools.description: Read an ERC-20 allowance on Base at a pinned block before an AI proposes spending. Returns exact units, decimals and provenance. Does not approve or transfer tokens. Version 253064e6ce6110d8. Requires 0.01 native USDC per call on Base; shared paid pilot limits apply.

tools.name: base_uniswap_v3_lp_accounting_audit
tools.description: Read official Base Uniswap V3 NFT and pool state at one canonical block hash. Reconcile exact token inventory and fee-growth checkpoints against optional reported raw amounts. Return signed discrepancies, reproducible inputs and uint128 accounting semantics. Recorded tokensOwed may include withdrawn
